| Parameter | Effect |
|---|---|
| `startTrim`, `endTrim` | Fractions removed from each end; negative extends |
| `nextPull`, `previousPull` | Signed control-point pulls toward neighbouring tour points |
| `rotationRadians` | Rotation around the trimmed segment’s midpoint |
| `perpendicularOffset` | Shift perpendicular to the rotated line |
| `alongSlide` | Shift along the rotated line |

**Nothing is clamped.** Over-trimming can reverse endpoints; negative pulls push away.

Order is **trim → control-point pulls → rotate → offset/slide**. Missing neighbours contribute no pull. Setting all seven parameters to zero restores straight geometry.
